name: Washington State Summer Con
blurb: A four-day pop-culture convention in Puyallup spanning movies, TV, comic books, anime, collectibles, gaming and music.

editions.venue: Washington State Fair and Events Center
editions.evidence: Homepage: 'Celebrate Year 10 of Summer Con with us — June 17–20, 2027' and 'JUNE 17-20, 2027 ● PUYALLUP, WA'; 'Event Info: The next Washington State Summer Con will be in June 2027 ... held at the Washington State Fair and Events Center in Puyallup, WA.'

notes: The /2027-guests/ page's only content under the 'Summer Con Featured Guests – June 2027' heading is a 'Years of Memories at Summer Con' photo gallery recycling old convention and guest photos from 2023-2025 (including one of the late Jason David Frank, filename 'jdf.jpg'), not a live 2027 roster, so guests are none-yet. A separate 'Featured Guests – see who is coming!' link on the homepage still points to /2026-guests/, the prior (already finished) edition.
